visualCharacteristics: Data table up to 768px wide with a grey bold header row, 2px row dividers and left-aligned text; optional white/grey striped rows. Below 480px each row stacks into one column with the header text as a bold label above each value.
contentPattern: Each block row is a table row and each cell a table cell. The first row is the header row (rendered as th in thead) unless the no-header option is set. Cells may hold inline formatting, links and short lists. Rows with fewer cells stretch their last cell across the remaining columns.
usage: Tabular data such as fees, toll relief thresholds and test booking details on Service NSW transaction pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for genuine tabular data with column headings. For side-by-side text and media use columns-text-media; for lists of links use cards-link-tile.
